installPage.heroSubtitle: Add it to your home screen for one-tap access to diagnostics, wherever you're working.
installPage.step1Title: Look up a code or scan report
installPage.step1Body: Enter a DTC code or upload a full scan report — no account needed to start.
installPage.step2Body: Our AI diagnostic copilot analyzes the codes, symptoms, and vehicle data.
installPage.step3Body: See prioritized causes with confidence levels and the tests to confirm each one.
installPage.step4Body: Follow the guided checklist to confirm the fix before closing out the job.
installPage.androidStep2: Tap the menu (⋮) in the top right.
installPage.iosStep2: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of the screen.
installPage.iosStep3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
installPage.iosStep4: Tap "Add" in the top right to confirm.
installPage.benefit1Body: Launch straight to DTC Technician from your home screen — no typing a URL or digging through bookmarks.
installPage.benefit2Body: Runs like a native app, with more screen space for diagnostics and reports.
installPage.benefit3Body: It's the same DTCDecoder account you already use — no separate download, no App Store or Play Store required.
installPage.androidBrowserNote: Works in Chrome, Edge, or Samsung Internet.
installPage.iosBrowserNote: Must use Safari — Chrome, Firefox, and other browsers on iPhone can't install apps, due to Apple's restrictions.

installPage.faq1A: Make sure you're using a supported browser (Chrome/Edge on Android or desktop, Safari on iPhone) and that you've visited the site before. Some browsers only offer the option after a short delay.
